summary: @or-sdk/adapters preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `scripts.preinstall` runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-mangled loader (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, unpacks and chmods it, and then invokes `execFileSync(bun, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])` against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. That sibling is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle using a classic string-array rotator (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());... }` with a large hex/int constant array). The package's advertised surface is a small HTTP adapter class in `src/Adapters.ts`, which has no need for a Bun runtime or a `math_init` bootstrap. Both the loader and the payload are obfuscated, and the payload is executed under an alternate runtime at install time, evading Node-level inspection of what actually runs on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
